part-IIIA__sec-21D.heading: Dealing with credit information
part-IIIA__sec-21D.html: A credit provider must not use or disclose credit eligibility information about an individual unless the credit provider is permitted to do so under this section. Each credit provider must comply with the applicable requirements before the credit provider discloses that information.

defs.text: means information about an identified individual.
has the meaning given by section 6G, and includes a bank or other entity that supplies credit in the course of a business.
